name: dsh-im-extras
description: Plugins for the DeepSeek Harness IM host (dsh-im): per-chat router sessions with task workers, a streamed progress message, interactive cards for Lark and QQ, session capability grants, reply polishing, a sticker library and an operator panel.

scripts.build: pnpm run harness && pnpm -r run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run harness && pnpm -r run typecheck
